mentions.name: Dolphin Whispers Chat
mentions.description: This Android app lets users attempt to chat with dolphins at sea, displaying a spectrogram and chat text during exchanges. The upcoming version is being adapted to work with wearable display glasses so users can view the spectrogram, chat text, and the dolphins' reactions near the boat without moving their head or refocusing, since exchanges are short and fleeting.
mentions.problem: Exchanges with dolphins are usually very short and fleeting, and moving the head or refocusing makes users lose important, fleeting information about the exchanges.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists and boaters attempting to communicate with dolphins at sea.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am finishing the latest version of Dolphin Whispers Chat application, an Android app for trying to chat with dolphins at sea.

mentions.name: Dolphin Whispers
mentions.description: Android app that enables chatting with dolphins using underwater whistles. The current version works well and is about to be used with free dolphins near Spain. The project does not support captivity and does not want its work to promote captivity or increase revenues from captivity.
